title: What My Grandmother Told Me About Khadijah
script: Narrator: [warmly] My grandmother used to tell me stories about the Prophet's companions every time I visited her small house.
Narrator: Her favorite story was always about Khadijah, the Prophet's first wife, and the very first person to believe in him.
Narrator: [admiringly] She told me Khadijah was a respected businesswoman in Makkah, known for her honesty long before she ever married the Prophet.
Narrator: [seriously] When the Prophet received his very first revelation, he returned home shaking, deeply shaken by what had happened.
Narrator: [gently] My grandmother said Khadijah didn't hesitate for even a moment. She wrapped him gently and calmed his racing heart.
Narrator: [reassuringly] She told him that Allah would never let him down, because he was honest, kind, and always helped those around him.
Narrator: My grandmother always paused here and said, listen carefully, this is the important part of the story.
Narrator: [supportively] Khadijah then used her own wealth and her respected position to protect and support him for many difficult years.
Narrator: When the wider community turned against the early Muslims, she stood firmly beside him, never once turning away.
Narrator: [reflective] My grandmother said Khadijah's belief was so calm and steady that it gave the Prophet strength during his most uncertain moments.
Narrator: She often reminded me that a true partner doesn't just share your comfortable days, but also your hardest and most frightening ones.
Narrator: [remembering] Every time she finished the story, my grandmother would squeeze my hand and say, remember Khadijah, remember her patience.
Narrator: I didn't fully understand the story as a child, but I understand it much better now, as an adult.
Narrator: Loyalty like Khadijah’s can be quiet and steady. It shows up quietly, again and again, exactly when it's needed most.
Narrator: [softly] My grandmother passed away a few years ago, but her voice still returns to me whenever I hear Khadijah's name.

options: The Prophet's first wife and the first person to believe in him
quiz.explanation: The narrator's grandmother described Khadijah as the Prophet's first wife and the very first person to believe in him.

quiz.explanation: The narrator says her grandmother taught that loyalty like Khadijah's shows up quietly, again and again, exactly when it's needed most.
